chunks: About mut'ah, so he said: "It is like some of your bondwomen."

key_terms.إِمَائِكَ: your bondwomen; female slaves owned by a man
key_terms.الْفُضَيْلُ: Al-Fudhayl, the named questioner in the report
key_terms.يَسَارٍ: Yasār, the patronymic element completing the narrator's name

ai.seo_question: How did the Imam عليه السلام describe mut'ah in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a question posed to the Imam عليه السلام about mut'ah (temporary marriage) and gives a brief juridical comparison in reply. The report relates to fiqh discussions on the legal status and practical ruling of mut'ah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4595 - Al-Fudhayl ibn Yasaar asked him about Mutah (temporary marriage).
Imam (as) said: "It is like some of your bondwomen."
